2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: FCX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.86% | 1M: +26.18%), DOW ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.49% | 1M: +13.93%). Energy strong: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.08% | 1M: +5.68%). Industrials strong: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +16.28%).

3. Which sectors are lagging?

Real Estate soft: AMT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -5.24%), CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -5.67% | 1M: -6.14%).

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

Weakness concentrated in select large caps and real estate/healthcare names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTC (1W: +15.67%), SLB (1W: +12.44%), AMAT (1W: +12.02%), VLO (1W: +12.08%), AMZN (1W: +9.22%). Major divergence: multiple mega-caps (MSFT RECOVERY, META RECOVERY, TSLA RECOVERY vs AAPL/NVDA/AMD BELOW TREND) — this is a MAJOR divergence, so treat moves as tactical until confirmed.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%), AMAT ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.02% | 1M: +12.74%), AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%), NVDA BELOW TREND (1W: -2.11% | 1M: -0.06%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +1.34% | 1M: -2.59%). Tech breadth estimate: 12/19 positive — internal rotation with notable large-cap dispersion.

8. Financials Outlook?
Constructive but uneven: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.60% | 1M: +10.04%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.95% | 1M: +7.13%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.36% | 1M: +7.23%), CME BELOW TREND (1W: -2.68% | 1M: -2.39%). Financials breadth estimate: 14/20 positive — cyclical tilt but select names lag.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Cautious: UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.25% | 1M: +6.30%), PFE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.19% | 1M: +0.59%), JNJ CORRECTION (1W: -1.43% | 1M: +2.22%), ABBV BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.30%). Healthcare breadth estimate: 10/15 positive — defensive names mixed with idiosyncratic weakness.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Cautionary stance: favor exposure to Materials and Energy leaders (FCX, SLB, PSX ABOVE TREND) and selective Industrials (LMT, BA ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to large-cap tech names showing structural weakness (AAPL, AMD, NVDA BELOW TREND). Style: mixed / no clear leadership; treat tech strength as tactical until divergence resolves.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.67% | 1M: +12.47%), SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.44% | 1M: +18.02%), AMZN ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.22% | 1M: +8.54%) — watch for follow-through. BEARISH: AAPL BELOW TREND (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -6.43%), AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -9.08% | 1M: -8.33%), ABBV BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.30%) — monitor for deeper mean reversion.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (estimate 7/7 positive), Energy (estimate 8/8 positive) — strong momentum and news support. BEARISH: Utilities (2/6 positive) and pockets of Tech (12/19 positive but several large-cap tech BELOW TREND) — watch leadership dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: reclaiming the 1M downtrend would reduce downside risk (currently BELOW TREND). AAPL: failure to hold recent 1M lows would deepen BELOW TREND posture. JPM: sustaining above the 1M breakout would confirm ABOVE TREND continuity. INTC: weekly follow-through above gap would confirm continuation of ABOVE TREND move.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+60): Boeing wins large defense contracts; price confirming — BA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.97% | 1M: +17.05%). PSX (+55): refinery deal news; PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.88% | 1M: +1.63%) — sentiment confirming price action.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
ABBV (-50): downgrade headlines and price BELOW TREND (1W: -4.03% | 1M: -1.30%) — sentiment confirmed. QCOM (-55): negative downgrade in news list; monitor QCOM for confirmation (not in detailed table here). ORCL (-50): options bet headline noted — watch given broader tech dispersion.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership. INTC ABOVE TREND, SLB ABOVE TREND and AMZN ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: large-cap tech divergence (AAPL, NVDA, AMD BELOW TREND) and select negative sentiment (ABBV) — watch for trend breaks.
